item.title: Twelve years of distributed SQLite
item.description: In September 2014 I published a short post announcing rqlite. The idea was simple: take SQLite, put a Raft log in front of it, and replicate every write to a cluster so that the loss of a node did not mean the loss of the data. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
item.description: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database. (1 source: infoq)
